messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "caregiver should know where naloxone is kept and how to use it"
set: ["caregiver should know where naloxone is kept and how to use it", "caregiver must know where you keep it and how to use it", "caregiver should give naloxone", "family or close friends should know how to give injection in emergency", "do not drive until you know how it affects you", "any healthcare provider should know you are taking it", "keep medicine where others cannot get to it", "avoid driving and other tasks that need alertness until you know how it affects you", "talk to doctor and pharmacist about low blood sugar and how to manage it", "avoid driving or hazardous activity until you know how it affects you", "adult caregiver should give child injections", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "reliever inhaler is kept on hand", "do not apply lotions or creams to the area where it is placed", "keep the medication where others cannot get to it", "do not drive or operate machinery until you know how it affects you"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
